en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a grand three‑story classical building partially framed by large trees. The facade has many rectangular windows, decorative stonework, and a central entrance with stairs and a balcony above. The scene appears to be a town square or street in front of the building. Printed caption text at the bottom left reads "Vänersborg, Enskilda Banken" and a small number "3360" appears at the bottom right.
